domain: all unordered distinct pairs of the 1684 observed source street segments
failure_policy: union of dependent consecutive-stop bus connection IDs; walking and metro fixed
parameter_grid: all W and K from baseline.json, both bus and bus_metro
grouping: exact failed-connection union; preserve every signature pair and physical street pair
selection_rule: exhaustive regardless of runtime; sampling and automatic scope reduction are prohibited
interaction: C_count = joint_loss - first_single_loss - second_single_loss; C_share = C_count / 65677
interpretation: complete deterministic pair census within the screened model; no claim of complete operating-service coverage
